title: Clean stale merged branches and detached worktrees
outOfScope: Do not delete any Dependabot branch or modify/close any of the seven open Dependabot pull requests.
Do not delete, force-push, retag, or rewrite any release tag or provider Release.
Do not delete the unmerged codex/release-v0-5-57-full-url-adopter-repair branch or its worktree without a separate evidence-backed disposition.
Do not delete the dirty active codex/release-v0-5-56-adopter-delivery worktree; it requires a separate lifecycle recovery or closure Work Item.
Do not change product code, tests, workflows, release metadata, or quality gates.

riskAssessment.reason: Deleting a stale branch or worktree is destructive and must be limited to exact, independently verified targets. The unmerged v0.5.57 patch has no equivalence evidence and is a retained exclusion, not an open cleanup unknown.

reasons: Finish produces human-benefit reports classified as a trust surface, which requires strict verification.
Branch/worktree cleanup needs lifecycle, scope, and ownership verification.

executionDecision.reason: User authorization is recorded; deletion remains conditional on exact merge, PR, worktree, and cleanliness evidence.

preReviewWarnings: Review branch ancestry, open PR ownership, worktree status, and post-deletion absence before any destructive command.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The already-merged codex/release-v0-5-55-adopter-delivery branch is absent both locally and on origin after cleanup receipts prove it has no open PR and is an ancestor of origin/main.

The clean detached v0.5.56 metadata worktree and clean detached quality-acceptance worktree are removed from Git worktree registration and filesystem only after exact HEAD/status evidence is recorded.
The unmerged v0.5.57 branch/worktree and all seven Dependabot PR branches remain intact and are explicitly recorded as retained exclusions.
The dirty active v0.5.56 adopter-delivery worktree remains intact and is recorded as a separate lifecycle-recovery obligation rather than being deleted.
The Work Item is archived through the normal governed PR lifecycle, then its own local and remote branch are removed by ai-close-work-item.
guidelines: Preserve evidence before any destructive action and fail closed on an unmerged branch, an open PR, a dirty worktree, or an unresolved ownership record.
Make no product behavior, release, test, or security-gate changes while performing repository hygiene.

intent.problem: The prior v0.5.58 Work Item cleanup completed its own branch lifecycle but historical release branches and detached worktrees remained, so the repository was not actually free of stale local/remote execution identities.
constraints: Only exact targets proven merged, clean, unowned by an open PR, and outside retained exclusions may be deleted.
Retain the unmerged v0.5.57 recovery branch/worktree and all seven open Dependabot branches.
Use the governed Work Item lifecycle; do not bypass quality, archive, PR, merge, or closure gates.
intent.rationale: A clean repository is part of delivery integrity: future work must not accidentally reuse obsolete release identities or ambiguous worktrees.

rawUserRequest: The branch cleanup is incomplete; finish all cleanup and record the authorization in the Contract.

declaredIntent.summary: Remove only evidence-proven stale merged branches and clean detached worktrees, while retaining active or unmerged identities.
